summary.fr: Philosophe écossais, il soutient que la morale moderne, coupée des traditions et des communautés qui donnaient sens aux vertus, n'est plus que fragments, et prône un retour à l'éthique d'<ph id='aristotle'>Aristote</ph>.
summary.en: Scottish philosopher who argues that modern morality, cut off from the traditions and communities that gave the virtues their meaning, survives only in fragments, and who calls for a return to <ph id='aristotle'>Aristotle</ph>'s ethics.
